title: Lock Deposit Terms for Rate Lock Commitment Products
content:
**Rate Lock Commitment** deposit terms. The lock deposit is the money Larkspur Home Lending holds for an extended lock. It is set as a percent of the loan amount at lock. A rate of 0.000 means no deposit is required.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Lock deposit (percent of loan amount at lock) | Due within (business days after the lock date) | Accepted payment methods |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 0.000 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 0.500 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 1.000 | 3 | ACH debit, wire, check |

**How the deposit is disposed of (the same for every product)**

| Event | Treatment of the deposit |
|---|---|
| The loan closes under the lock | Credited on the Closing Disclosure: yes |
| Larkspur denies the loan | Refunded: yes |
| The borrower withdraws or cancels | Refunded: no |
| The lock expires and is not relocked within the relock window | Forfeited: yes |

### Notes

- Only the Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock (0.500 percent) and the Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock (1.000 percent) call for a deposit.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on a loan amount at lock of $400,000.00, a 0.500 percent deposit is $2,000.00 and a 1.000 percent deposit is $4,000.00.
